items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: You heard of Ashil Pacquet playing clarinet, haven't you? He played good, he played good.

ctx.x: He played, that time he played with him and Pacquet and Dave Perkins. Huh. Well, Lawrence Vega played with you. Yeah. And Pacquet and Dave Perkins and you, I forgot who the others were, but anyhow, that's really, and you know Pacquet played good music. Pacquet played good music.
You heard of Ashil Pacquet playing clarinet, haven't you? He played good, he played good.
